title: MONTE Standard — Strict Biceps Curl

checks.text: Straight bar only, supinated closed grip, heels no more than 30 cm from a rigid vertical wall. Head, upper back and buttocks contact the wall; both feet stay planted. No EZ bar or dumbbell substitutions.
Start motionless, elbows fully extended within the athlete’s natural pain-free range, bar clear of supports. Record total bar-and-plate load.
Curl with simultaneous elbow flexion, keeping upper arms near the torso and the three wall contacts. No hip drive, knee dip, torso swing, shoulder thrust, bounce or assistance.

Reach full controlled elbow flexion with the bar approaching the shoulders without resting on the torso; pause visibly and lower under control to the start. Side and front-oblique views must allow range and contact assessment.

safety: Do not attempt a dangerous maximum for a rank. Use conservative loads, appropriate safety equipment and competent spotting. Pain or an unclear camera angle is not a reason to repeat a dangerous lift. Ranking is optional.
evidence: Continuous unedited footage showing setup, complete attempt and finish; load markings and total load, date/identity linkage and bodyweight/category attestation must be reviewable. Additional angles may be required. No automated form or identity certification.
visualExamples: Pending qualified review; no fabricated example footage is supplied.
